title_en: Planned Hanwha Aerospace Field Practicum, Winter Session 2026 (English Speaking Score Required)
summary: Interested students in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, Computer or Industrial Engineering in their third year or above may apply for the planned Winter Session 2026 recruitment-linked field practicum at Hanwha Aerospace. Applicants must hold a valid TOEIC Speaking or OPIc score and must submit an application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office and, at the same time, apply through the Hanwha recruitment system between 15 October 2026 and 23:59 on 18 October 2026. The programme is still planned, and details may change when it is confirmed.
applies_to: Optional; for interested students only. Applicants must major in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Industrial Engineering and be in their third year or above. Students expected to graduate in February or August 2027 are given priority. Applicants must hold a TOEIC Speaking or OPIc score that is valid as of the document submission deadline (expected 18 October).

conditions: The programme is only planned, and the details may change when it is confirmed.
Only majors in Aerospace, Electrical, Mechanical, Computer or Industrial Engineering in their third year or above are eligible.
Students expected to graduate in February or August 2027 are given priority.
An official language score is required, and only TOEIC Speaking or OPIc is accepted.
The language score is accepted only if it is valid as of the document submission deadline (expected 18 October).
You must submit the application to the department office and apply through the Hanwha recruitment system at the same time; both are required.
Selected students must pay the tuition by 23 November 2026.
Hanwha Aerospace is a defence company, so a background check required by law is part of the selection process.
The practicum is worth 3 credits (Field Practicum 3) and requires at least 150 hours.
steps: Check the schedule, eligibility requirements and positions in this notice in advance.
Make sure you hold a TOEIC Speaking or OPIc score that will be valid on the document submission deadline (expected 18 October).
Between 15 October and 23:59 on 18 October 2026, submit the application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office (no room number is given in the notice).
At the same time, submit your application documents through the Hanwha recruitment system.
Attend the job interview on your assigned day between 4 and 6 November 2026, expected to be held at the Hanwha Aerospace Seoul site.
If you are selected on 20 November 2026 (expected), pay the tuition by 23 November 2026.
In December 2026, complete the background check confirmation and the pre-employment medical examination.
Complete the practicum from 28 December 2026 to 28 January 2027 (at least 150 hours).
translation:
[Hanwha Aerospace] Notice of Planned Field Practicum Semester for the Winter Session of the 2026 Academic Year (English Speaking Score Required)

The Department of Aerospace Engineering plans to operate a field practicum semester (현장실습학기제) during the winter session of the 2026 academic year.

Interested students should check the schedule, eligibility requirements and other details below in advance.

(Please note that this programme is still planned, so the details may change when it is confirmed.)

1. Host organisation: Hanwha Aerospace (recruitment-linked)

2. Practicum period: 28 December 2026 to 28 January 2027 (Field Practicum 3 [현장실습 3] / at least 150 hours)

3. Student requirements
- Major: Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Industrial Engineering
- Third year or above (students expected to graduate in February or August 2027 have priority)
- An official language score is required (TOEIC Speaking or OPIc only). *Only scores valid as of the document submission deadline (expected Sunday 18 October) are accepted.

4. Planned number of selections
- Aviation Business Division | R&D | Materials | Pangyo | 2–3 students
- LS Business Division | R&D | Mechanical/Aerospace | Changwon | 2–3 students
- LS Business Division | R&D | Electrical/Electronic | Changwon | 2–3 students
- PGM Business Division | R&D | Mechanical/Aerospace | Daejeon | 2–3 students
- PGM Business Division | R&D | Electrical/Electronic | Daejeon | 2–3 students
- PGM Business Division | R&D | Software/Computer | Daejeon | 2–3 students
(Columns: organisation | main job category | job subcategory | work location | number selected)

5. Schedule
- Course registration (application) [수강신청]: Thursday 15 October 2026 to Sunday 18 October 2026, 23:59
 * You must submit the application form to the Department of Aerospace Engineering office and, at the same time, also submit your documents through the Hanwha recruitment system.
- Job interview: one day between Wednesday 4 November and Friday 6 November 2026 * Expected to be held at the Hanwha Aerospace Seoul site.
- Final selection: Friday 20 November 2026 (expected) * Tuition must be paid by Monday 23 November.
- Confirmation of background check results and pre-employment medical examination: during December
 * As a defence company, Hanwha Aerospace includes a background check in its selection process as required by law.

6. Contact: Department of Aerospace Engineering office (contact details are given in the original notice).
